caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded jug with a narrow neck and a small lip at the top. The jug is beige or light tan in color, with smudges and spots of a darker tone scattered across its surface. The main feature on the front of the jug is a blue line drawing of a horse, rendered in a stylized manner, with the horse’s head turned towards the neck, one front leg lifted, and its mane and tail clearly indicated. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller depiction of the same jug viewed from a slightly different angle, showing the jug’s handle on the right side and a second blue line drawing of a horse bending its head down, possibly grazing, with the tail clearly outlined. Both horse motifs are simple, monochromatic, and drawn in the same blue color, contrasting sharply with the beige background of the jug. The overall composition places the larger jug centrally, with the smaller inset image confined to a rectangular space at the upper right. The drawing is executed on a plain, off-white background with faint pencil lines framing both the main jug and the inset image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
